title: Potential GDP and Underlying Inputs
description: CBO estimates of potential GDP and its underlying inputs (labor force, capital services, TFP). This is a legacy standalone publication; the last release was August 2019. Post-2020, these variables are included in historical_economic (Pub 55022) and economic_projections (Pub 51135).

output_files.quarterly_{vintage}.csv: Quarterly potential GDP and unemployment rates from Supplemental Table 2 (1949q1-2029q4)

notes.post_2020: After January 2020, potential GDP data is available in historical_economic (55022) and economic_projections (51135). This dataset provides the pre-2020 standalone format.
notes.base_year: Values are in chained 2012 dollars (the base year used in 2019 publications)

potential_lf_productivity.unit: Ratio of potential GDP to potential labor force

nfb_capital_services_index.description: Index of capital services, nonfarm business

nfb_potential_tfp.description: Potential total factor productivity, nonfarm business

nfb_potential_labor_productivity.unit: Ratio of potential GDP to potential hours worked

nfb_capital_share.description: Capital share of income, nonfarm business
